course_name_th: โครงงานคณิตศาสตร์
instructor: แนวคิดโดยอาจารย์สิทธิโชค ทรงสอาด
description: A project-based mathematics course focused on topic selection, planning, evidence gathering, progress communication, and final seminar presentation under advisor supervision.

badges.name: Starter
badges.req: Open the course and begin collecting XP.

badges.name: Explorer
badges.req: Reach 120 XP and complete at least one module.

badges.name: Project Master
badges.req: Complete the course with at least 80% accuracy.

badges.name: CLO1 Understand Starter
badges.req: Collect quick-check evidence in Project Scoping and Advisor Alignment

badges.name: CLO2 Analyze Readiness
badges.req: Collect SBRA candidate evidence in Literature Review and Project Planning

badges.name: CLO3 Apply Builder
badges.req: Collect planning draft evidence in Literature Review and Project Planning

badges.name: CLO4 Evaluate Progress
badges.req: Collect progress presentation evidence in Project Execution and Progress Review

badges.name: CLO4 Evaluate Seminar
badges.req: Collect seminar presentation evidence in Report Writing and Seminar Presentation

badges.name: CLO5 Apply Discipline
badges.req: Collect advisor log review evidence in Project Execution and Progress Review

modules.title: Project Scoping and Advisor Alignment
modules.summary: Clarify project interests, shape a feasible topic, and connect it with advisor feedback.

modules.title: Literature Review and Project Planning
modules.summary: Search, evaluate, and synthesize relevant sources to frame a project direction and plan.

modules.title: Project Execution and Progress Review
modules.summary: Carry out the project with advisor consultation, evidence logging, and progress reporting.

modules.title: Report Writing and Seminar Presentation
modules.summary: Prepare the final report, refine communication, and present the project in seminar form.

clos.label: Search for relevant sources and project ideas appropriately.
Analyze related work to define a meaningful mathematics project direction.
Design a suitable study or analysis process for the selected project problem.
Present project progress and findings clearly and appropriately.
Work with discipline, responsibility, and respect for advisor and project roles.
